description: Read one grade's book in one currency. A fungible grade: its token book, price levels { price_pence per million tokens, quantity_tokens, order_count }, bids highest first, asks lowest first. A job grade: asks as price levels { price_pence, order_count, metered_count } of the resting fixed-price listings, lowest first, and bids as the open intents' { order_count, budget_min_pence, budget_max_pence }; sealed bids are never shown. depth 1 to 50 (default 10). Aggregates only: no seller, intent or buyer. Works without credentials.
